stories.title: Visitor Registration and Check-In
stories.iWantTo: register a visitor and upload their photo via a secure S3 process
stories.soThat: we maintain an accurate digital log of all arrivals while ensuring photo storage compliance
criteria: System validates mobile number against existing active visits to prevent duplicates
System generates a presigned S3 URL for secure photo upload
Record is created with 'Checked-In' status upon successful upload
Triggers async notification to the designated employee
stories.techNotes: Requires integration with S3 presigned URL API; implement RLS and DB trigger trg_verify_employee_active.

stories.title: Visitor Check-Out
stories.soThat: the visit history is finalized and the record can be archived for compliance
criteria: System records the precise end time
Ensures check_out time is chronologically after check_in time
Record is moved to archived state
stories.techNotes: Enforce CHECK (check_out > check_in) constraint at the database level.

stories.title: Employee Visitor Portal
stories.iWantTo: view my specific incoming visitor logs
stories.soThat: I can stay informed about my appointments while maintaining data privacy
criteria: PII must be appropriately masked based on system configuration
Results are restricted to the logged-in user's own data only
stories.techNotes: Use PostgreSQL RLS with SET LOCAL app.current_user_id to ensure BOLA mitigation.

stories.title: Administrator User Management
stories.iWantTo: manage employee active status and visitor types
stories.soThat: the system reflects current organizational staff and registration categories
criteria: Admin can toggle is_active status for employees
Admin can update the Visitor Type dropdown labels
Changes are reflected immediately in registration flows
stories.techNotes: Restricted to Admin role via controller-level validation.

stories.title: Visitor Data Reporting
stories.iWantTo: export visitor logs as a CSV file
stories.soThat: I can perform compliance auditing and department-specific reporting
criteria: Support filtering by date range, visitor type, and employee
Download triggers a CSV file export

stories.title: Data Privacy Lifecycle Maintenance
stories.iWantTo: automatically anonymize PII and purge old media
stories.soThat: the application remains compliant with data retention and privacy policies
criteria: S3 files are purged after 14 days
PII for records older than 30 days is anonymized via background worker
Process runs nightly without interrupting system performance
stories.techNotes: Requires a cron-based background job. S3 lifecycle policies should be utilized for media.
